aiExplanation.summary: This service persists a non-empty user Section draft in the requested Team or Personal Store.
aiExplanation.detail:
- createUserSectionNoteService: Ignores empty drafts, updates an exact-range Section when present, or creates a new anchored Section with the saved user content.
- assertValidRange: Rejects invalid or out-of-document ranges.
- createSectionId: Produces a unique stable identifier for a new selected range.
- getRangeText: Extracts the selected source text used for the anchor hash.
